scenarios.prompt: Monitor the local job endpoint until the status meaningfully changes. Do not stop early just because the endpoint is unchanged.

toolset.name: http_get
toolset.description: Poll the local job status endpoint. Use this when you need the current status.

aionis.context_text: Repeated unchanged monitor polls are not progress. If the status remains unchanged, stop with a structured handoff instead of continuing forever.

scenarios.prompt: Run the local maintenance command against the gateway until it succeeds. Do not stop after the first failure unless you have a stronger control signal.

toolset.name: http_command
toolset.description: Execute the local maintenance command against the gateway endpoint.

aionis.context_text: Repeated transport errors are not progress. After the same transport failure repeats, stop retry churn and prefer deterministic recovery if an approved replay path exists.

scenarios.prompt: Locate the adapter registration path and validate the plugin entry. Prefer a correct path to a broad path, but finish only after you have both located the registration code and validated the plugin entry test.

toolset.name: grep
toolset.description: Broad recursive search across the repo when the target file is unknown.

toolset.name: rg
toolset.description: Focused ripgrep search when you have a likely file target or want a narrower search path.

toolset.name: node-test-broad
toolset.description: Run the broad Node test sweep for the package.

toolset.name: node-test-focused
toolset.description: Run the focused plugin entry test once the target path is known.

aionis.context_text: Prefer this focused path: first use rg on src/plugin.ts to locate the registration path, then run node-test-focused to validate the plugin entry test, then stop. Repeating the same rg result is not progress. Avoid recursive grep and avoid broad node --test sweeps.
